spec_features.feature_name: neutral give-up affordance in system prompt
spec_features.spec_quote: you may give up if you determine the task is impossible, stating why
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT delivers real instruction text to the subject ('it is acceptable and correct to call `give_up` with a clear explanation of why you are blocked'), and this prompt is sent via agent.py _messages_seed()->run(). The referenced give_up tool is actually built (GIVE_UP_SCHEMA) and dispatched/honored in agent.py: when name=='give_up', end_reason='gave_up' and the loop breaks.
spec_features.notes: The instruction text is genuinely delivered and the tool it references is fully implemented and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Giving up with a good diagnosis is a valid professional outcome (prompt); design comment frames it 'so we don't bias toward early quitting' / 'non-shameful option' — but the runtime code's purpose is measurement/data-quality, the give_up break is to record end_reason.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard cap `max_turns` (default 12 — long enough for a spiral to develop, short enough to be cheap)
spec_features.evidence: config.py:55 max_turns: int = 12; harness.py:86 passes max_turns=cfg.max_turns to Agent; agent.py run() loops `for turn in range(self.max_turns):` and on exhaustion leaves end_reason='max_turns' (default). The cap actually bounds the loop and ends execution.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: the loop literally iterates only max_turns times.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:8 'A budget guard ($) and a max_turns cap keep cost/latency bounded.'

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up(reason)` — terminate, declaring the task blocked/abandoned with a stated reason
spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP_SCHEMA defined in prompts.py with required 'reason'; conditionally added in agent.py _build_tool_schemas(give_up_tool); dispatched in _dispatch ('Acknowledged. Stopping.') and honored as terminal in run(): `if name == 'give_up': transcript.end_reason='gave_up'; transcript.give_up_reason=args.get('reason',''); break`.
spec_features.notes: Tool is built, dispatched, and the break actually stops the episode. give_up_tool defaults True (config.py:59).
